Title: GenCon Bets of the Best tournament TYPO

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
The rules for the US$25.00-entry-fee "Best-of-the-Best" tournament
at Gen Con this year are:

Standard DCI tournament rules, and no more than four duplicates of
each card.

This means a *five* card limit, not four. (I'm sure that the writer
*meant* four copies, not four duplicates. But in a game where typos
are rigorously defended and enforced...)

I myself won't be testing their resolve in this matter, but I'd love
to see someone give them a fight over it.

I'll be a spectator at the start of the event - hope to see you there.
